name: Etoacetazene
summary: Etoacetazene is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects, first developed in the 1950s as part of the research that led to better-known compounds such as etonitazene. It is an analogue of etonitazene where the 5-nitro (NO2) group has been replaced by an acetyl (COCH3) group. It is described as having "reduced but still significant" potency compared to etonitazene itself.

pharmacology.text: Etoacetazene (Etonitazene 5-acetyl analogue, 5-acetyldesnitroetonitazene) is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects, first developed in the 1950s as part of the research that led to better-known compounds such as etonitazene.

uses.en: It was made in research and has never been a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究中合成的化合物，從未成為藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究中合成的化合物，从未成为药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Nitazenes are extremely potent opioids. They cause drowsiness and nausea, and the main danger is overdose, in which breathing slows or stops. Many deaths have been linked to them, often when they were sold as or mixed into other drugs. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。尼秦類是藥效極強的鴉片類藥物。它們會引起嗜睡和噁心，最主要的危險是過量，導致呼吸變慢或停止。已有許多死亡事件與它們有關，常是被當作其他藥物販售或摻入其他藥物時發生。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。尼秦类是药效极强的鸦片类药物。它们会引起嗜睡和恶心，最主要的危险是过量，导致呼吸变慢或停止。已有许多死亡事件与它们有关，常是被当作其他药物贩售或掺入其他药物时发生。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: Etoacetazene was made in the 1950s during the same Swiss research that produced etonitazene. It differs from etonitazene by carrying an acetyl group where etonitazene has a nitro group.
fact.zh: Etoacetazene 是 1950 年代在產生 etonitazene 的同一項瑞士研究中合成的。它和 etonitazene 的差別在於，etonitazene 上的硝基在它身上換成了乙醯基。
fact.zhHans: Etoacetazene 是 1950 年代在产生 etonitazene 的同一项瑞士研究中合成的。它和 etonitazene 的差别在于，etonitazene 上的硝基在它身上换成了乙酰基。
